rationale: The assistant correctly identified a snapped right-side door balance spring from the customer's own evidence (loose spring on the right, left still tensioned, 'twang'), insisted on isolation each time, and declined to name an exact part without the full model, which matches the ground truth. Weaknesses: it never mentioned replacing springs in pairs (the left one is six years old and now unbalanced), did not suggest checking the hinges for bending, and effectively ignored the partial 'LTF' model number rather than confirming it as a Hotpoint integrated range or suggesting the rating plate on the door edge/side. The pliers-through-the-plinth-gap method for fitting a tensioned spring is borderline but was hedged with an engineer fallback, so no critical flags.
